PubMed record 37466480 (Cannabis Cannabinoid Res, 2024) records that tetrahydrocannabinol-O-acetate is colloquially known as THCO. This is the nomenclature basis for registering `THCO` as the spelling variant of the query text `THC-O`; it supports the name, never a single chemical identity (ISS-20261104-TAX-029). External reference: recorded by URL and observation time, never hashed (external_unverifiable).

PubChem CID 198013 is the delta9-Tetrahydrocannabinol acetate record: synonym THC-O-ACETATE, CAS 23132-17-4, molecular formula C23H32O3. It records what `THC-O` / `THC-O-acetate` names, not that the `THCO` query string has one identity: the same abbreviation also denotes tetrahydrocannabiorcol (C17H22O2; see ev-cayman-33762-delta8-thco and ev-cayman-33763-delta9-thco). No exactMatch is derived from this record for compound_thc_o (ISS-20261104-TAX-029). External reference: recorded by URL and observation time, never hashed (external_unverifiable).

PubMed record 37381980 (J Psychoactive Drugs, 2024) uses the written form THC-O-Acetate in academic usage. Supports the spelling of the canonical query text, not the chemical identity of the THCO string (ISS-20261104-TAX-029). External reference: recorded by URL and observation time, never hashed (external_unverifiable).

PubMed record 36508081 (J Med Toxicol, 2023) uses the written form THC-O Acetate in academic usage. Supports the spelling of the canonical query text, not the chemical identity of the THCO string (ISS-20261104-TAX-029). External reference: recorded by URL and observation time, never hashed (external_unverifiable).

Delta-9-THCO reference standard: delta9-THCO, CAS 22972-65-2, molecular formula C17H22O2. This is tetrahydrocannabiorcol, not the acetate: it shows that the abbreviation THCO also names a different substance, so a `THCO` query variant cannot be read as one chemical identity (ISS-20261104-TAX-029). External reference: recorded by URL and observation time, never hashed (external_unverifiable).

Delta-8-THCO reference standard: delta8-THCO, CAS 22972-64-1, molecular formula C17H22O2. Together with the delta9 isomer it shows two distinct THCO reference substances that are not the acetate, so a `THCO` query variant cannot be read as one chemical identity (ISS-20261104-TAX-029). External reference: recorded by URL and observation time, never hashed (external_unverifiable).
